story:
At G&T Roofing & Home Improvements, we believe that quality roofing and home improvement work should be accessible to everyone. That is why we built the business on three principles: honest pricing, expert craftsmanship, and exceptional customer service. It is also why no job is too small for us — a six-shingle repair gets the same attention as a full replacement, and the estimate is free either way.

We understand that your home is your most valuable investment. Whether you need a complete roof replacement, an emergency leak fixed, seamless gutters, siding, chimney work or a skylight, we approach every project with the same level of care. We use premium materials from trusted industry-leading suppliers — GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed and IKO — and we name them on the estimate so you can look up the product line and the warranty terms yourself.

G&T Roofing is led by Alex and Luis, two owners who have built their reputation on reliability, quality work and fair pricing. They answer their own phones: Alex at (570) 880-1640 and Luis at (570) 453-8725. The person who walks your roof and writes your estimate is the person running the crew on install day, and the person who picks up if you call six months later.

Our shop is at 77 Center St in Pittston, and we work across all of Northeast Pennsylvania — Scranton, Wilkes-Barre, Hazleton, Carbondale, Stroudsburg and the surrounding areas. That matters more than it might sound. After every major storm, Pennsylvania homeowners get door-knocked by out-of-state crews who collect the insurance settlement and move on. We are here year-round, at an address you can drive to.
